answer: Because the orchard forfeiture is applied at exit, the whisper ledger totals each burn, and the ocean audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 138 aliases therefore destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 52% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
